title: Creatuwheels
subtitle: Creatures On Wheels Packaging Design
description: The packaging for 'Creatuwheels' brings a playful and educational approach, reflecting the toy’s purpose of teaching geometric shapes and transforming into vehicle-like creatures. From flat layout to assembled box, the design highlights color theory, movement, and imagination.
tileVersion: Toy packaging design exploring geometric play, color theory, and transformation.

highlights.title: Color Blocks
highlights.summary: Cyan, magenta, yellow, and grey—core colors tied to early learning and basic shapes.

highlights.title: Shape Confetti
highlights.summary: Dynamic triangle patterns hint at creativity and play variety.

highlights.title: Iconography
highlights.summary: Outlined abstract figures showcase transformation and movement.

highlights.title: Typography
highlights.summary: Bold logo with tagline 'creatures on wheels' to establish brand identity.

highlights.title: 3D Packaged Product
highlights.summary: Geometric patterns flow seamlessly across the box with space for product info and barcode.

result: Packaging that visually communicates the toy’s creativity, education, and play value—appealing to both kids and adults.
